name: AirTrunk JHB1 (Johor Bahru)
notes: AirTrunk's first Johor hyperscale data centre, 150+ MW, opened July 2024 in Johor Bahru (per AirTrunk release and Xinhua). Initial phases delivered over 50 MW for anchor technology customers. Combined Malaysia investment RM9.7bn (~US$2.2bn), >420 MW IT load across campuses.

name: AirTrunk JHB2 (Iskandar Puteri)
notes: JHB2 announced 13-14 Feb 2025 with Johor Menteri Besar; cloud and AI-ready campus scalable to more than 270 MW in Iskandar Puteri, Johor. Under construction; JHB2 funding of US$2.3bn reported 2025.

name: AirTrunk JHB3 / JHB4 (two new Johor Bahru campuses)
notes: AirTrunk announced two additional Johor Bahru hyperscale campuses (JHB3/JHB4) adding 280 MW combined (per AirTrunk official release, verified in methodology). Status announced; construction timeline not disclosed. Capacity is full-buildout figure.

name: YTL Green Data Center Park (Kulai)
developer: YTL Power International / YTL Data Centers (with NVIDIA, Sea)
notes: YTL Green Data Center Park in Kulai/Iskandar, Johor: ~275 acres (111.29 ha), 500 MW full-buildout park concept, Malaysia's first solar-powered DC park; groundbreaking with Sea Aug 2022. First phase operational - YTL AI Cloud facility powered by NVIDIA GB200 (NVL72) is live (20 MW first facility per trade/directory sources; 600 MW AI facility with NVIDIA reported by press). Capacity figures are campus buildout concepts; individual JDC phases vary.

name: Princeton Digital Group JH1 (Sedenak Tech Park)
notes: PDG delivered Phase One (52 MW) of its 150 MW AI-ready JH1 campus in Sedenak Tech Park (STeP), Kulai, Johor on 3 Jul 2024, ~14 months after land acquisition from JLand Group (31 acres). TNB ESA secured per PDG release. Capacity 150 MW is full campus; phase 1 52 MW delivered.

name: Princeton Digital Group JH2 (Johor)
notes: PDG Malaysia location page (methodology-verified) lists JH2 approximately 16 km from JH1 in Johor; official page discloses 200 MW and 300 MW site concepts for the Johor platform. Status announced/planning; no delivery date published.

name: Bridge Data Centres MY06 (Sedenak)
notes: Bridge MY06 hyperscale campus in Sedenak, Johor (~40 acres, ~100 MW across three buildings per directory, status operational per getcommercialproperty); MIDA release records construction of the fourth hyperscale campus in Johor (ByteDance anchor reported by trade press). Capacity figure from directory is C-grade; operator existence A.

name: Vantage JHB1 (ex-Yondr Johor campus)
developer: Vantage Data Centers (acquired Yondr Group campus)
notes: Vantage JHB1 (Sedenak Tech Park, Johor) 300+ MW critical IT load at full buildout; Vantage agreed to acquire Yondr's Johor campus for ~US$1.6bn after Oracle leased the first phase (Mingtiandi, Dec 2025). Historic Yondr identity retained in notes to avoid double-counting. Status under construction/leased-up phase one.

name: Keppel DC Johor 1
notes: Keppel DC Johor 1 is a built-to-suit facility in a Johor industrial park (official Keppel page, methodology-verified; also described by techstories as the early 10 MW-scale Johor DC). Capacity not officially disclosed in MW.

name: TM Nxera Iskandar Puteri Data Centre (IPDC)
developer: TM Nxera (Telekom Malaysia + Singtel/Nxera JV, entity ST Dynamo DC)
notes: TM Nxera signed a multi-year TNB electricity supply agreement (Jan 2026) securing 280 MW for its AI-ready, hyperconnected data centre campus in Iskandar Puteri, Johor; first phase of commercial operations scheduled 2026. Status under construction (power secured).

name: DayOne Nusajaya Tech Park campus (NTP1-3)
notes: DayOne (GDS rebrand) Nusajaya Tech Park campus operational since 2023 - NTP1/NTP2/NTP3 with ~69.5 MW combined per directory (C-grade capacity) and direct connectivity to Singapore; US$3.54bn financing secured for Malaysian campuses (DCD). Capacity is guidance, not operator-confirmed.

name: DayOne Kempas Tech Park facility
notes: DayOne operates across Kempas Tech Park, Johor (official page) with an extra-large facility reported under construction with ~108 MW capacity (directory/blog C-grade figure). Status under construction per trade/directory reporting; operator existence A.

name: Microsoft Southeast Asia 3 cloud region (Johor Bahru)
notes: Microsoft announced (Nov 2025) Southeast Asia 3 (SEA3) cloud region in Johor Bahru as its second Malaysian region, under its US$2.2bn Malaysia investment plan. Region-level evidence (A); physical facilities not yet individually identified - map to operator/permit evidence when available. Status announced.

name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Malaysia West 2 (Kulai), ap-kulai-2
notes: OCI Malaysia West 2 (Kulai) region ap-kulai-2 became available 2026-02-02 (official OCI release note). Region-level evidence (A); physical facility mapping requires Kulai/Johor planning/utility/operator evidence. Recorded as cloud-region project in Johor division.

name: Open DC JB1 / JB2 (Johor Bahru)
notes: Open DC official site (methodology-verified) lists six data centres across Cyberjaya, Johor Bahru, Kedah and Penang, including JB1/JB2 in Johor Bahru. Operator-level claim (A for existence of service), capacity/location details C.

name: Alibaba Cloud Malaysia (Johor) cloud facilities
notes: Methodology records Alibaba Cloud expansion in Johor (press reporting of region/local facilities, e.g. The Edge); official Alibaba pages are A for cloud-region claims but no official facility page with Johor site detail was verified in this run. Status announced; treat capacity/location as unverified.

name: AWS Asia Pacific (Malaysia) Region ap-southeast-5
notes: AWS Malaysia Region (ap-southeast-5) opened 21 Aug 2024 with 3 Availability Zones; planned RM29.2bn investment to 2038. Region-level evidence A; directory sources (C) place AZ facilities in Cyberjaya/Selangor and Technology Park Malaysia (Klang Valley). Recorded in Selangor division (Cyberjaya/Sepang cluster per methodology).

name: Microsoft Azure Malaysia West region (Greater Kuala Lumpur)
notes: Microsoft's first Malaysian cloud region, Malaysia West, in Greater Kuala Lumpur with 3 AZs (officially GA). Greater KL physical sites mostly in Selangor (Cyberjaya cluster). Region-level A; no individual facility addresses disclosed. Recorded in Selangor division.

name: Google data centre, Elmina Business Park (Shah Alam)
developer: Google (Pearl Computing Malaysia) / Sime Darby Property (built-to-suit)
notes: Google's first Malaysia hyperscale data centre at Elmina Business Park (Shah Alam, Selangor) broke ground via Sime Darby Property built-to-suit lease (US$2bn Google investment, May 2024 announcement); second data centre phase (SDP EBP II) leased to Pearl Computing per DCD. Status under construction; completion expected per press (early 2026+).

name: Vantage KUL1 (Cyberjaya I)
notes: Vantage KUL1 (31 MW) in Cyberjaya, Selangor is operational/complete per Vantage release and W.Media (2026). Note Vantage has reportedly considered selling its ~US$2bn Malaysian assets - ownership may change.

name: Vantage KUL2 (Cyberjaya II campus)
notes: Vantage KUL2 groundbreaking at Jalan Cyber Point 4, Cyber 8, Cyberjaya on 6 Aug 2024 (with MITI minister); adjacent campus of 4.8m sq ft delivering 436 MW across six data centres at full buildout, with on-campus 500 MVA TNB substation per methodology. Status under construction.

name: NTT Global Data Centers Cyberjaya 1-6 (incl. CBJ5/CBJ6)
notes: NTT operates Cyberjaya data centres (1-6); Cyberjaya 5 lists ~12 MW critical IT load (methodology-verified); DE-CIX Malaysia expanded availability into NTT's Cyberjaya DC (Oct 2025), confirming operations. Capacity figure is per-facility (CBJ5) - campus total not aggregated.

name: Equinix KL1 / KL2 (Cyberjaya)
notes: Equinix KL1 in Cyberjaya operational; KL2 expansion reported (methodology-verified official pages; MIDA/DCD/CRN Asia report expansion/land/topping-out leads). Capacity not disclosed on official page.

name: TM Klang Valley Data Centre (KVDC), Cyberjaya
notes: TM KVDC in Cyberjaya is TM's flagship data centre (official TM pages, methodology-verified); Twin Core data centres also referenced. No public MW disclosure.

name: Digital Realty / CSF TelcoHub 1 (Cyberjaya)
notes: Digital Realty entered the Malaysian market via acquisition of CSF Advisers, owner of TelcoHub 1 in Cyberjaya (Data Centre Magazine, Jan 2026). Legacy CSF and new Digital Realty names refer to the same asset - do not double-count. Status operational.

name: AIMS Cyberjaya (Block 3) / AIMS Group
notes: AIMS operates Menara AIMS carrier hotel (KL) and Cyberjaya expansions including Block 3 (methodology-verified official pages; MyIX/DE-CIX nodes). Interconnection-focused operator; capacity not disclosed.

name: Open DC CJ1 (Cyberjaya)
notes: Open DC CJ1 in Cyberjaya is the operator's flagship (official site, methodology-verified; IP ServerOne also colocated in CJ1 building). Operator-level claim A; capacity/location specifics C.

name: Basis Bay Cyberjaya DC.1 / DC.2 (STT GDC JV)
developer: Basis Bay / ST Telemedia Global Data Centres
notes: Basis Bay data centre in Cyberjaya (official Keppel Data Centres page listing, methodology-verified) with STT GDC JV; DC.1/DC.2 plus Johor NCIP campus. Capacity not disclosed.

name: EdgeConneX Cyberjaya / Kuala Lumpur edge data centres
notes: EdgeConneX Malaysia locations (KL/Cyberjaya) per official page (methodology-verified); individual building status/address requires Cyberview/MIDA/directory corroboration (C for specifics). Recorded in Selangor (Cyberjaya cluster).

name: IP ServerOne CJ1 (Cyberjaya)
notes: IP ServerOne CJ1 Tier 3 colocation in Cyberjaya (official page, methodology-verified); small/enterprise colo in the Open DC CJ1 building. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Sunway Construction Serendah data centre contract
notes: Blog/trade reporting of a Sunway Construction data centre contract in Serendah (Hulu Selangor, Selangor). C-grade lead only - client, capacity and planning trail not yet verified; included for completeness of Selangor pipeline.

name: AIMS Menara AIMS carrier hotel (Jalan Aik Hua)
notes: Menara AIMS in Kuala Lumpur is Malaysia's core carrier hotel and interconnection hub (MyIX/DE-CIX presence; methodology-verified official pages). Classified as commercial colocation/interconnection facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: NEXTDC KL1
notes: NEXTDC official page claims Malaysia KL1 (65 MW, Tier IV design). Physical site ambiguity: marketed as Kuala Lumpur but likely Cyberjaya/Selangor per methodology caution - verify planning/operator/land evidence before mapping. Recorded in WP Kuala Lumpur division per marketing label.

name: Open DC PE1 / PE2 (Bayan Lepas)
notes: Open DC PE1/PE2 in Penang; PE2 confirmed at Phase 4, Medan Bayan Lepas, Bayan Lepas Industrial Park (Exabytes colocation at DH6/Open DC PE2). Operator-level claim A for service existence; capacity/location specifics C. Penang IX interconnect nodes nearby.

name: Open DC D8-1 (Kulim Hi-Tech Park)
notes: Open DC D8-1 data centre in Kulim Hi-Tech Park, Kedah per Open DC official site (methodology-verified; six facilities across Cyberjaya, Johor Bahru, Kedah, Penang). Kulim Hi-Tech Park confirmed as Kedah's main high-tech industrial park (KHTP official site). Capacity/location specifics C.

name: SACOFA data centres (Kuching and Miri)
notes: SACOFA (Sarawak telecom infrastructure operator) operates data centres in Kuching (Lot 367, Jalan Satok - operational interconnection facility) and Miri (directory listings; 2 locations per datacenters.com). C-grade directory evidence; no official SACOFA facility page with MW data found. Sarawak energy trail (Sarawak Energy hydro) may drive future DC growth - no hyperscale facility verified.

name: Port Dickson Data Centre Infrastructure Hub campus (158 ha)
notes: Gamuda announced groundbreaking at Port Dickson's Data Centre Infrastructure Hub for a new 158 ha data centre campus in Negeri Sembilan (Jan 2025, official Gamuda news). Campus-level project; tenant/operator and capacity not yet disclosed - monitor for named operator, TNB/OSC evidence.
